title: Hanasato Minori — To Sparkle More〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Neighborhood
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(Everything went horrible this morning...
I was almost late for school, I forgot to do my homework...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I left tomorrow's worksheets I was supposed to do at the MORE MORE HOUSE!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness I realized that before getting home...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They're due tomorrow, so I need to absolutely make sure to do them...!
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Hello!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I didn't think anyone else would be here since we don't have practice or any meetings today...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But the door was open.
Is someone here...?)
Shizuku...! Sh-Shizuku...!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Ah, she's beautiful right down to her fingertips...! This joint performance is the best thing that has ever happened...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Minori and Haruka are also really cute!
I could watch them do this dance forever...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
You're shining so bright, Airi!
Th-This is too amazing. I'm starting to tear up...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
M-Minori?!
Wh-Wh-When did you get here...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: J-J-Just now!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay...
Umm... I'm sorry. I didn't mean for you to see that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No!
Don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Were you watching yesterday's Idol Lovers?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Yes! As an idol fan, that show now has a very special place in my heart...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I decided to take a break after finishing up some work, but I got a bit carried away... Before I realized it, I was shouting at the top of my lungs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know exactly how you feel!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Videos make things so convenient since you can watch your favorite parts as much as you like!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll sometimes go to see a show or concert live and still pay to see the recording of it later...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Me too! Yes, the atmosphere is always amazing, but you won't necessarily get to see your favorite idols up close. These videos give you that power...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I know exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Your performances from yesterday really are something else. I can't help but watch them over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: As I mentioned to you all yesterday, that was the most I'd ever seen you shine... I was so moved!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
And the audience was so incredible!
I'm sure you all noticed as well, but they went crazy for every group that performed... It was electric!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, I'm sure that you spread hope to a huge number of people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's really great to hear!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also had a lot of fun yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: ReLight and MORE MORE JUMP! both did their absolute best and shined like crazy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Seeing that made me think...
Idols really are the best...!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I can't be satisfied with just this yet!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can't just keep thinking that I wanna shine and sparkle like the others...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I need to keep working harder!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to shine more and more like they did!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My training paid off yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I still have a lot of work left to do since I'm still just getting on my feet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I've gotta keep getting better to produce the same results as yesterday. No, even better results...! Because I want to spread hope to as many people as I can!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You really are a wonderful person, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I thought you shined so brightly yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But you are right now as well.
You're always facing forward, doing your best and not letting anyone or anything get you down...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
That's why you fill me with so much hope.
Just like all your fans.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, I believe you will succeed!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: You're going to shine even brighter, and become the best idol ever!!!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And I promise to keep doing my best to give you all the support I possibly can! I'll also be looking forward to your next show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Saito...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also plan on doing my absolute best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I've gotta keep trying...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(To become the best idol ever...
To do what Airi did yesterday!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I wanna shine brighter and brighter...!)
